leadText:
Pokémon 3: The Ultimate Soundtrack is the English soundtrack to the third Pokémon movie, Spell of the Unown: Entei. It was released in the United States on April 3, 2001 by . It has also been released in German, Danish, Dutch and Swedish.

The CD also contains two music videos—the opening battle from the movie with Pokémon Johto (Movie Version), and Pokérap GS—which can be viewed by putting the CD into a computer. Many of the songs were sung by and can also be found on the Totally Pokémon CD.

In , this album was available in a 2-disc bundle with 's score.

The album is available on Spotify. It was re-released by Laced Records on August 15, 2025 and subsequently re-titled Pokémon 3: The Movie.

==Trivia==
This is the only Pokémon CD that has been released in .
All but three of the songs on this album can be obtained on other albums.
The Game, Do Ya Really Wanna Play?, Never Too Far From Home, and the karaoke versions of Pokémon Johto, All We Wanna Do, Two Perfect Girls, and Pokérap GS are the only songs from the Totally Pokémon album that aren't on this album.
